name: ai_land_traffic road network
source: GTA:SA nodes.dat car paths + navi links (via newtraffic nodes.lua), surface scan with the claude-mcp probe
coords: MTA world metres; a lane runs from points[1] to points[2] (Lua indices); right-hand traffic

conventions.node ids: GTA path node id = area*4095 + index; nodes[].gps = v_radar vehiclenodes id (area*65536 + index)
conventions.lane.index: 0 = innermost lane (next to the centre line / median), counting outward to the right
conventions.lane.offset: metres to the right of the link centre line, in the lane travel direction
conventions.lane.points: lane centre line [start, end] with z; junction ends are trimmed back so turn curves fit
conventions.connection.curve: cubic Bezier control points [p0,p1,p2,p3] from lane end to next lane start; absent when the lanes touch
conventions.connection.turn: straight | left | right | uturn (uturn only at dead ends)
conventions.connection.signal: traffic light phase (GTA navi value): 1 = roughly north-south arms, 2 = east-west arms; links.trafficLight is the raw navi value
conventions.node.type: road (2 links) | junction (3+) | deadend (1) | parking (GTA parking stub; lanes into it have lane.parking = true)
conventions.lane.next / lane.prev: connection ids (connections.json) leaving / entering the lane
conventions.link.lanesAB / lanesBA: lane count travelling a->b / b->a; oneway when one of them is 0
conventions.link.estimated: lane data inherited from the neighbouring link (missing / broken navi record)
conventions.link.surface: "unpaved" when the probe surface scan found mostly dirt/sand/grass under the link (hint for manual removal); absent = paved
conventions.signals.json: signal groups: one per real intersection (signalled junction nodes within 35 m along the road); phases = signal values used by its connections
conventions.flags: GTA node flags: highway, emergency (emergency-vehicles-only path in GTA), parking, roadblock
